the foaming agent could be a good choice for the drying process, and the air temperature and relative humidity are the main factors that affect the drying rate and quality of the roselle calyxes extract.
foam mat drying of roselle calyx extract could be used for producing high quality dried product.

the foaming agent ovalbumin can be used to produce a dried roselle calyce extract with high antioxidant activity, good colour quality, and a short drying time.
